name: policy-ceiling
description: Makes an organization's managed limits act as ceilings and floors over each person's merged settings (retention, model, effort, permission mode, sandbox) instead of fixed values, and shows in /policy the requested value, limit and effective value for each rule.

maxCleanupPeriodDays.title: Max transcript retention (days)
maxCleanupPeriodDays.description: Ceiling for cleanupPeriodDays. 0 means no ceiling. Read from managed settings only.

deniedModels.title: Denied models
deniedModels.description: Comma-separated model names or aliases replaced in the settings `model` (e.g. opus[1m]), and cleared from env ANTHROPIC_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL. Not an allowlist: --model and /model are not capped. Read from managed settings only.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model used when the requested one is denied. Empty means Claude Code's default. Read from managed settings only.

maxEffort.title: Max effort
maxEffort.description: Ceiling for effortLevel (top-level and per model): low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Empty means no ceiling. Read from managed settings only.

forbiddenModes.title: Forbidden permission modes
forbiddenModes.description: Comma-separated permissions.defaultMode values that fall back to default, e.g. bypassPermissions,acceptEdits. Read from managed settings only.

requireSandbox.title: Require sandbox
requireSandbox.description: Floor: sandbox.enabled is always true and sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands false. Read from managed settings only.
